environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' running with IRSA role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/profile-svc-role. Pod has unrestricted egress via default VPC CNI configuration. No NetworkPolicy applied. IAM role has dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Scan on table 'user_profiles' with no condition keys. Pod service account token automounted. IMDS v1 enabled on node (IMDSv2 not enforced). No egress filtering or DNS-based controls.
